title: Banks Act Directive D10/2015 — Matters related to changes to the AMA operational risk management and measurement system used for the calculation of required capital for operational risk
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Matters related to changes to the AMA operational risk management and measurement system used for the calculation of required capital for operational risk.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Matters related to changes to the AMA operational risk management and measurement system used for the calculation of required capital for operational risk.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Matters related to changes to the AMA operational risk management and measurement system used for the calculation of required capital for operational risk. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
